title: The Quarry
subtitle: A break by block id
description: The plainest break task: a block id and a number. Thirty-two stone, counted by the game's own break event, completing the moment the thirty-second breaks. What counts is the act, not the drop — silk touch and a voided drop count just the same, because the event fires for the break either way.
The two quests below it are the same field filtered two different ways — by a block tag, and by a block state — so the family reads as one mechanism with three lenses, the way the kills above it do.
